name: Replace disciplinarity and interdisciplinarity with integrative praxes and

representative_ideas: Replace disciplinarity and interdisciplinarity with integrative praxes and knowledge formations, framing knowledge as ecological and situated rather than privileged
common_problems: Disciplinarity assumes a privileged site of valid knowing, obscuring the partial and situated nature of knowledge; interdisciplinarity as a concept fails to address the goal of living well
solution_approaches: Propose integrative praxes (practices differentiated by existential situation and aimed at living well) and knowledge formations (ecological, dynamic bodies of knowledge that develop in relation with other entities) as alternatives to traditional disciplinary structures
story: Reframe knowledge production from discipline-based accumulation to ecological integration; shift the test of truth from effective action to living well through ongoing conversation among multiple knowledge formations
application: Interdisciplinary research methodology, knowledge organization in higher education, collaborative research across cultural and historical boundaries

title: Integrative Praxes: Learning from Multiple Knowledge Formations

name: Detect video anomalies by modeling normal patterns at

representative_ideas: Detect video anomalies by modeling normal patterns at the patch level with joint appearance and motion conditioning, rather than global feature reconstruction
common_problems: Existing diffusion-based video anomaly detection methods operate at the feature level and fail to capture fine-grained local anomalies, which are often small objects exhibiting deviations in both appearance and motion
solution_approaches: Patch-based diffusion model trained exclusively on normal patterns, integrated with motion and appearance conditions to guide coherent generation of both semantic content and temporal dynamics for local regions
story: Reframe video anomaly detection from global reconstruction error to fine-grained patch-level generation with multi-modal guidance, recognizing that anomalies manifest as localized deviations in both visual appearance and motion trajectories
application: Surveillance security systems, automated monitoring of public spaces, industrial safety inspection, anomaly detection in traffic videos

title: Video Anomaly Detection with Motion and Appearance Guided Patch Diffusion Model

name: Combine chain-of-thought reasoning with regression-aware training in a

representative_ideas: Combine chain-of-thought reasoning with regression-aware training in a two-stage framework to improve numerical score prediction in LLM-as-a-judge systems
common_problems: LLM-as-a-judge methods using cross-entropy loss neglect the numeric nature of score prediction, while existing regression-aware approaches ignore the benefits of chain-of-thought reasoning for evaluation quality
solution_approaches: Two-stage TRACT framework: first fine-tune seed LLM to generate CoTs, then retrain with combined objective (CE loss for CoT reasoning + regression-aware loss for score prediction) to align discrete reasoning with continuous scoring
story: Reframe automated evaluation from classification or regression alone to structured reasoning-plus-regression paradigm; bridge discrete reasoning generation and continuous score prediction through staged knowledge distillation
application: Automated essay scoring, content quality evaluation, model-based evaluation for RLHF, educational assessment automation

title: TRACT: Regression-Aware Fine-tuning Meets Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for LLM-as-a-Judge

name: Simulate content creator behaviors under information asymmetry using

representative_ideas: Simulate content creator behaviors under information asymmetry using LLM agents with belief mechanisms and fast-and-slow thinking to enable accurate long-term recommender system evaluation
common_problems: Traditional recommender system evaluation focuses on immediate user feedback while ignoring long-term creator dynamics; existing simulators fail to model information asymmetry where creators only access partial feedback data rather than full platform data
solution_approaches: Deploy LLM-empowered CreAgent using game-theoretic belief mechanisms and fast-and-slow thinking framework, fine-tuned via Proximal Policy Optimization, to simulate strategic creator behaviors under realistic information constraints
story: Reframe RS evaluation from static user-centric metrics to dynamic multi-stakeholder ecosystem simulation; elevate creator modeling from behavioral cloning to strategic agent-based simulation under information asymmetry
application: Long-term recommender system evaluation, platform-creator interaction modeling, fairness and diversity algorithm testing in two-sided markets

title: LLM-Empowered Creator Simulation for Long-Term Evaluation of Recommender Systems Under Information Asymmetry

name: Reveal that multimodal LLMs exhibit strong halo effects

representative_ideas: Reveal that multimodal LLMs exhibit strong halo effects in hiring evaluations, particularly when processing images, causing non-job-related information to bias competency assessments
common_problems: AI hiring systems using MLLMs are vulnerable to halo effects where non-job-related multimodal information (extracurriculars, social media images) disproportionately influences competency evaluations, with image-based assessments showing stronger bias than text
solution_approaches: Systematic empirical investigation using hypothetical job applications with controlled non-job-related information across text and image modalities, measuring bias through Likert-scale competency ratings to quantify the halo effect
story: Expose the blinding risk of multimodal context in high-stakes AI decisions; reframe MLLM evaluation reliability from accuracy to bias resilience against irrelevant signals, highlighting the unique vulnerability of visual modalities
application: AI hiring system auditing, bias mitigation in recruitment algorithms, multimodal model safety evaluation, high-stakes decision system validation

title: Blinded by Context: Unveiling the Halo Effect of MLLM in AI Hiring

name: Use chain-of-thought prompting with few-shot and active learning

representative_ideas: Use chain-of-thought prompting with few-shot and active learning to enable LLMs to both score and explain open-ended science assessments in K-12 education
common_problems: Existing automated methods handle structured assessments (math/CS) but fail to provide meaningful explanations for open-ended formative assessment responses in K-12 science education, limiting their utility for learning
solution_approaches: Combine few-shot prompting, active learning, and chain-of-thought reasoning with GPT-4 in a human-in-the-loop framework to generate both scores and explanatory feedback for middle school Earth Science assessments
story: Reframe automated assessment from black-box scoring to transparent, explainable evaluation through reasoning chains; bridge the gap between automated efficiency and formative educational feedback via human-in-the-loop validation
application: K-12 science education assessment, automated grading with feedback, formative evaluation systems, teacher assistance tools

title: A Chain-of-Thought Prompting Approach with LLMs for Evaluating Students’ Formative Assessment Responses in Science

name: Enable zero-shot generation of rare and structured concepts

representative_ideas: Enable zero-shot generation of rare and structured concepts by optimizing seed selection in the noise space rather than retraining the diffusion model
common_problems: Text-to-image diffusion models fail to generate uncommon concepts and structured objects (e.g., hand palms) due to long-tail training data distribution, causing under-representation of rare categories
solution_approaches: SeedSelect technique that identifies optimal generation seeds in the noise space using a small reference image set, enabling correct generation of rare concepts without model retraining or finetuning
story: Reframe the data scarcity problem from a model training limitation to a seed space exploration problem, transforming frozen diffusion models into adaptable generators capable of zero-shot rare concept synthesis and semantic data augmentation
application: Few-shot recognition benchmarks, semantic data augmentation for tail classes, generating rare anatomical structures, content creation for underrepresented categories

title: Generating Images of Rare Concepts Using Pre-trained Diffusion Models

name: Resolve the perception-distortion tradeoff by adaptively skipping diffusion

representative_ideas: Resolve the perception-distortion tradeoff by adaptively skipping diffusion steps, using coarse steps for fidelity and fine steps for perception learned via reinforcement learning
common_problems: Image super-resolution suffers from the perception-distortion tradeoff where high fidelity (pixel accuracy) and high perceptual quality are mutually exclusive, while diffusion models are computationally expensive
solution_approaches: SkipDiff with two-stage decoupled sampling: coarse skip approximation for high-fidelity prior followed by fine skip refinement using deep reinforcement learning to adaptively select time steps, skipping intermediate computations
story: Reframe the perception-distortion dilemma from an unavoidable compromise to a controllable continuum through adaptive step allocation, enabling simultaneous optimization of both metrics with accelerated inference
application: Real-time image enhancement, photography editing software, mobile device super-resolution, medical image upscaling

title: SkipDiff: Adaptive Skip Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity Perceptual Image Super-resolution

name: Unify facial attributes and expression control in 3D

representative_ideas: Unify facial attributes and expression control in 3D face generation by performing conditional diffusion in the style code space rather than pixel space
common_problems: Existing 3D face generation relies on time-consuming per-sample optimization and cannot jointly control both facial attributes and expressions efficiently in a single framework
solution_approaches: TEx-Face pipeline comprising 3D GAN inversion with enhanced style code representation, conditional style code diffusion with a multi-condition denoiser, and 3D face decoding, supported by visual-language data augmentation
story: Elevate 3D face generation from iterative optimization to conditional generation in latent style space, establishing a new paradigm for efficient, disentangled control over both identity attributes and dynamic expressions
application: Real-time 3D avatar creation, facial animation for virtual production, personalized character generation, virtual reality applications

title: Controllable 3D Face Generation with Conditional Style Code Diffusion

name: Enable controllable music style transfer with minimal data

representative_ideas: Enable controllable music style transfer with minimal data by using time-varying textual inversion to capture multi-level mel-spectrogram features, bypassing the need for large audio-text paired datasets
common_problems: Text-guided music style transfer is severely limited by scarce audio-text paired datasets and the inherent difficulty of describing abstract musical nuances through text, preventing controllable high-quality music generation
solution_approaches: Time-varying textual inversion module that captures multi-level mel-spectrogram features at different timesteps, combined with a bias-reduced stylization technique for stable inference, enabling style transfer with minimal data
story: Reframe music style transfer from a text-supervised paradigm (which requires massive paired data) to an inversion-based paradigm that extracts fine-grained musical attributes directly from audio examples, enabling precise control over abstract musical styles without relying on textual descriptions
application: Music composition tools, audio production software, personalized music generation platforms

title: Music Style Transfer with Time-Varying Inversion of Diffusion Models

name: Define and solve the descanning problem by separating

representative_ideas: Define and solve the descanning problem by separating global color degradation from local distortions using a hybrid encoder-diffusion architecture
common_problems: Scanned documents and images suffer from complex compound degradations (color shifts, noise, artifacts) introduced by physical printing and scanning processes, with no systematic restoration methods or public datasets available
solution_approaches: DescanDiffusion combining a color encoder for global color correction with a conditional DDPM for local degradation removal, supported by a synthetic data generation scheme reproducing scanning artifacts
story: Establish 'Descanning' as a new fundamental image restoration task bridging physical document preservation and digital archives, demonstrating that scanned image degradation requires specialized treatment beyond generic restoration
application: Document digitization pipelines, archival restoration, scanned photo enhancement, automated document processing systems

title: Descanning: From Scanned to the Original Images with a Color Correction Diffusion Model

name: Bridge the performance gap for tail users in

representative_ideas: Bridge the performance gap for tail users in friend recommendation by combining self-training with knowledge distillation to overcome both label scarcity and neighborhood sparsity
common_problems: GNN-based friend recommendation systems exhibit severe performance degradation for tail users (those with sparse connections) due to label scarcity and neighborhood sparsity, creating unfair utility gaps between active and inactive users
solution_approaches: Two-stage self-training framework that first learns from head users then generates pseudo-labels for tail users, augmented with data augmentation-based self-knowledge distillation pretext tasks to enrich tail user representations
story: Reframe tail user recommendation from a cold-start data deficiency problem into a knowledge transfer problem where the model learns to bootstrap its own predictions and distill robust structural knowledge from data-rich head users to data-poor tail users, achieving equitable recommendation quality across the user spectrum
application: Social network friend recommendations, professional networking platforms, community detection systems

title: Tail-STEAK: Improve Friend Recommendation for Tail Users via Self-Training Enhanced Knowledge Distillation

name: Enable privacy-preserving inference by adapting language models to

representative_ideas: Enable privacy-preserving inference by adapting language models to process passkey-encrypted inputs through tokenizer and embedding transformations, eliminating the need to decrypt sensitive data on servers
common_problems: Remote deployment of language models requires transmitting sensitive user inputs over networks, creating interception vulnerabilities and forcing service providers to handle plaintext private data, violating confidentiality requirements
solution_approaches: Irreversible transformation of tokenizer and token embeddings to adapt pre-trained transformers for passkey-encrypted inputs, followed by fine-tuning on encrypted datasets, enabling end-to-end encrypted inference without decryption capabilities on the server
story: Reframe privacy-preserving inference from computationally expensive cryptographic protocols (HE/MPC) to a lightweight model adaptation paradigm that natively processes encrypted text, achieving practical privacy-security-performance trade-offs without architectural modifications or inference overhead
application: Cloud-based NLP services, healthcare text analysis, financial document processing, privacy-preserving chatbots

title: SentinelLMs: Encrypted Input Adaptation and Fine-Tuning of Language Models for Private and Secure Inference
